saw_lines: Home gym buyers ask how it arrives and whether it fits their room before they ask about the workout.
So a new buyer who sees no delivery answer in line one scrolls past, and the sale ends there.
Your 4 of 7 copy ads open on one UltraGym line. Test two new openers built on the 2.4 sq. ft. footprint and 150+ exercises.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 29 Oct 2026
points: 4 of your 7 copy ads open on the same “You’ve seen UltraGym” line, so one message repeats to the same buyers and they tune it out. Test two new openers on the 2.4 sq. ft. footprint and the 150+ exercises.

Your site answers how it ships, yet 0 of 7 ads mention shipping or delivery. A buyer weighing a machine this size wants that answer first, so they leave. Open new-buyer ads with one line on how the box arrives.
One exact copy runs in 4 of your 7 ads, so buyers who scroll past one see the same words again and tune out. Keep that copy, but change the opening line and creative in each ad.
None of your 7 ads carries a review count or shipped-order number, so new buyers have nothing to trust yet. Collect one real figure you can stand behind and lead the next ad with it.
